verdict.rationale: Cerebras offers a no-key Cloud Console playground and $5 free credits explicitly for prototyping 'before you spend a dollar,' which functions as an informal test environment separate from paid production usage. However there is no explicit sandbox/test-mode API, no separation of test vs production data, and no documentation framing this as isolating production data. Missing for 10: dedicated sandbox/test API keys or environments, explicit documentation of test-vs-production data isolation, and independent confirmation of safe experimentation without affecting production.
